pairs.difference: A (bracelet): soft band edges, and the raised note and speaker icons have crisp double-rim relief lines. This busy area sits only on the front icons, and the band's back edge fades out. B (planet): the ring has an even, dark, unbroken contour all the way round, and the stripes on the sphere are thin, evenly weighted graphic lines. Its background is almost edgeless (0.002, below the real range). The edge weight is the same at the focus as on the far ring.
pairs.fix: Let the far side of the ring fade softly into the planet. Keep only the near ring edge sharp. Paint the stripes as soft colour bands with no drawn borders.

pairs.difference: A (seahorse): soft, embossed edges. The spots are thin rings and the fins are lightly ribbed. B (sandcastle): crisp tower crenellations and dense sand speckle, inside the real range for subject and background. Both have the edge hierarchy of the real cards, so this vector gives no clear reason to pick either.

A (satellite): the solar panels are cut into a fine cell grid with even, sharp lines. There are rivet dots on every corner of the body and the outline is dark all round. Subject density is 0.208, above the real range, and the outline reading is out of range. B (ring box): a heavy dark rim around the lid and box, but the inside is a few smooth, broad surfaces, like the real chunky forms.
pairs.fix: Show the solar panels as smooth, glossy blue slabs with only a few soft divisions. Remove the corner rivets. Make the body edges soft rounded bevels, not drawn contours.

pairs.difference: A is the real computer card: crisp hierarchy at the monitor bezel and soft desk edges. B (rover): the ground is covered in dense, noisy speckle and pebble edges. The wheels have hard, dark concentric rims and the body has a dark outline all round (outline 0.2, well above the real range). Background detail is as sharp as the hero.
pairs.fix: Paint the ground as a smooth, softly shaded grey surface with only two or three large rocks. Shape the wheels with soft shading instead of dark rim rings, and let the body edges be defined by light, not lines.

pairs.difference: A (plane): soft, broad edges on the fuselage and wings. The window row is the only fine detail, and the cloud edges are soft. B (UFO): a sharp dark contour runs round the saucer rim, rivet dots are evenly spaced along the hull, and every light pod has a crisp ring. The legs also have hard outlines, so the edges are the same weight everywhere and there is no focus.
pairs.fix: Remove the rivets from the saucer. Let the rim edge turn softly into shadow underneath, keep the sharpest highlight only on the glass dome, and blur the light pods into soft glows.

pairs.difference: A (map): the map folds and coastlines are irregular, hand-drawn edges, and the lens rim is the sharpest point. The wood-grain background is busy (0.077). B (star plate): thin, ruler-straight sector lines and concentric circles, perfectly round star dots with crisp rims, and a hard double contour on the plate rim. The edges look like a precise vector diagram, not painted form.
pairs.fix: Paint the constellations as soft glowing dots joined by faint light trails, with no drawn grid lines. Give the plate rim a rounded, softly lit bevel instead of a hard double edge.

pairs.difference: A is the real drum-kit card: crisp hoops and lugs, with a soft stage and spotlight. B (gate): dense ironwork scrolls, every brick and paver outlined, and grass tufts drawn as small sharp marks. Subject density is 0.323 and background 0.122, far above the real range. The background is drawn as sharply as the gate.
pairs.fix: Simplify the gate to a few thick, rounded scrolls. Paint the brick pillars and the paving as soft colour blocks with faint joints, and blur the garden behind into soft shapes.

pairs.difference: A (helmet): the visor has an even, crisp dark outline, the neck hoses are cut into many evenly spaced rib rings, and the panel seams are perfectly regular. This matches the repeated crisp detail in the generated lessons. B (sneakers): busy mesh speckle and a hard floor line (outline -0.1), but the edge weight varies naturally. The evidence is weak both ways.
pairs.fix: Draw the neck hoses as smooth tubes with only three or four soft ridges. Let the helmet shell edges roll softly into shadow, and keep the one crisp highlight on the visor.

pairs.difference: A (control panel): every bolt, button ring, slider slot and wall seam has the same crisp double-groove edge. The wall rivets and seams behind are as sharp as the panel itself, so there is no edge hierarchy, and the outline reads near the top of the range (0.147). B (fan): the dense cage wires are the focus, while the curtain and wall are soft and broad.
pairs.fix: Keep the sharp edges on the screen and the buttons only. Paint the wall behind as a smooth, softly lit surface with no rivets or seam lines, and round the panel bolts into soft bumps.

pairs.difference: A (vending machine): a crisp outline round the cabinet and the window, and the glass is filled with tiny condensation dots and can rims, which is fine stipple. B (flask): soft glass edges, a few bubble rings, and low edge density (0.072, below range). A's busy speckle inside the glass leans generated, but weakly.
pairs.fix: Remove the water droplets from the glass and show the cans and bottles as simple soft colour shapes behind one clean reflection.

pairs.difference: A (rocket): a crisp rivet-dot row under the nose cone, double rings on the portholes, and a speckled concrete ground with ruled paving lines. Ground and horizon are drawn as sharply as the hero. B (coaster): the dense track rungs carry the focus, and the hills and clouds behind soften away.
pairs.fix: Paint the ground as a smooth, softly shaded pad with no paving joints or speckle. Remove the rivets and keep the porthole rims as single soft bevels.

pairs.difference: A (hiker): crisp edges on the face and hands, with soft clothing folds and a soft desert. B (cow and rooster): the spacesuits are covered in many sharp fold lines, seams and badge rings. Every grass tuft is a crisp separate mark, and the UFO has a ring of dotted lights. Subject density is 0.226, above the real range, and all edges are equally sharp.
pairs.fix: Make the spacesuits smooth and puffy with a few broad soft folds. Paint the grass as a soft green field with only a handful of tufts near the feet, and blur the UFO lights into soft glows.

pattern: Generated cards spread crisp, equal-weight edges everywhere: rivet rows, ruled panel grids, repeated rib rings, ground speckle and grass tufts drawn as sharply as the hero. That leaves no edge hierarchy and pushes edge density above the real range, often with an even dark contour round the hero. Real cards keep sharp edges for a few large form breaks at the focus and let backgrounds and secondary surfaces go soft.
